description: 先保存完整检索结果，再对固定三统计月官方解读各一次GET；完整原响应及日期/当前收件/版本限制留存，0带凭据请求。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import hashlib,json,time
import requests
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_official_pmi_interpretation_cause_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert not (OUT/'原官方解读收件.json').exists(),'原页固定GET已执行，不自动重试。'
search=json.loads((OUT/'官方域名两次查询_完整结果.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert search['public_search_query_count']==2
items=[
 {'stat_month':'2024-01','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/jd/sjjd2020/202401/t20240131_1947014.html','selected_from':'turn632search2'},
 {'stat_month':'2024-02','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202403/t20240318_1947992.html','selected_from':'turn632search10'},
 {'stat_month':'2024-03','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202404/t20240411_1948496.html','selected_from':'turn632search6'}]
assert [x['stat_month'] for x in items]==proto['fixed_source_prefix_months']
raw_dir=OUT/'raw';raw_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def fetch(item):
 started=now();t0=time.monotonic()
 receipt={**item,'requested_at':started,'method':'GET','authenticated':False,'redirects_enabled':False,'attempt':1}
 # 各原页只有一次公开请求；不使用项目数据提供方/到期访问配置。
 session=requests.Session();session.trust_env=False
 try:
  resp=session.get(item['url'],headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'text/html'},timeout=(10,25),allow_redirects=False)
  data=resp.content
  path=raw_dir/('nbs_interpretation_'+item['stat_month']+'.html')
  path.write_bytes(data)
  receipt.update({'received_at':now(),'http_status':resp.status_code,'response_url':resp.url,
   'content_type':resp.headers.get('Content-Type'),'response_date':resp.headers.get('Date'),
   'raw_path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'bytes':len(data),
   'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'status':'RAW_RESPONSE_SAVED' if resp.status_code==200 else 'HTTP_NON200_SAVED',
   'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t0})
 except Exception as e:
  receipt.update({'received_at':now(),'status':'REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY','error_type':type(e).__name__,
   'error':str(e),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t0,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
 finally:session.close()
 return receipt
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:receipts=list(pool.map(fetch,items))
obj={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'recorded_at':now(),'public_search_query_count':2,'raw_official_get_count':3,
 'authenticated_provider_requests':0,'budget_not_exceeded':True,'receipts':receipts,
 'preserve':'失败/缺页不换月份、不重试或填零。当前网页收件不是2024首次不可变版本。'}
(OUT/'原官方解读收件.json').write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for r in receipts:print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
